description:
Pussyfoot Records is back with a brand new E.P after popping out to get milk 15 years ago. 'The Shape Of Cats To Come' mixes the original Pussyfoot crew with some heavyweight up and comers, creating a journey through genre and sound.

Brand new Pussyfoot artist, Milo Clare, starts the E.P off with his signature downtempo R&B vocals, sleepy drums and bedroom eye's guitar on his track 'Get Enough'. Our good friend Sie offers up a panoramic orchestral cover of The Doors' psychedelic track 'Riders On The Storm' which has been 16 years in the making. Featuring Courtney Gray's vocals which will have you staring out your car window yearning for love lost.

We have a brand new track from Mr Pussyfoot himself Howie B titled 'Oh The Places You'll Go' an emotional electronic tune that builds beautifully with a banging breakbeat and a grinding treated guitar. Bringing up the rear we have Chinese artists Mickey Zhang & WHAI Featuring Howie B with 'Electric Horse' where traditional Chinese music and instruments meet EDM.

Track release dates -
Sie - Riders On The Storm (featuring Courtney Gray) 6th July
Mickey Zhang & WHAI Featuring Howie B - Electric Horse 27th July
Howie B - Oh The Places You'll Go 17th August
Milo Clare - Get Enough & Vinyl E.P 14th September.
